description: A versatile, lightweight aluminium frameset designed to handle everything from gravel and cyclocross to road riding, commuting and urban use. The Speedwork can also be built as a flat-bar bike, making it a highly adaptable option for a custom build. This Small (44cm) frameset is finished in Matt Charcoal Grey and includes the matching carbon fork with an alloy steerer. Specifications Model: Orange Speedwork Year: 2021 Frame Size: Small – 44cm Wheel Size: 700C Frame Material: 6061-T6 double-butted aluminium Fork: Carbon fork with alloy steerer Brake Type: Flat mount disc Rear Hub: 12 x 142mm Front Hub: 12 x 100mm Seat Tube: 30.9mm Bottom Bracket: 68mm shell Headset: Tapered Upper: ZS44/28.6 Lower: EC44/40 Effective Top Tube: 528mm Stack: 552mm Reach: 370mm Colour: Matt Charcoal Grey Condition New old stock – unridden and with tags. The frame has been in storage and may be slightly dusty, with some minor marks from storage. These are purely cosmetic and do not affect the frame's functionality. A great opportunity to pick up a versatile Orange frameset from stock at a clearance price. - Orange Bikes
